title: Polo (Collared) — Back, Wordmark + Endorsement
prompt: Premium top-down mockup of the BACK of a deep charcoal-black polo collared shirt (#0A1A1F) with ribbed collar, on a soft neutral studio surface. Across the upper back, centered: the Ongea Pesa orbital emblem, then the wordmark 'ONGEA PESA' in the custom wide athletic uppercase display font (white), and beneath it a thin soundwave underline in a green-to-cyan gradient (#34D399 to #22D3EE). Below that, smaller, the line 'by Nairobi Space of AI Tools  ·  NSAIT' in clean uppercase, the word NSAIT carrying a subtle violet-to-blue gradient (#6D28D9 to #2563EB). Tasteful scale (not oversized for a polo), perfectly spelled, realistic print-on-fabric texture, catalog quality.
negative_prompt: misspelling, oversized print, purple Ongea wordmark, microphone, dollar sign, busy background, wrinkles, mannequin, neon, low-res, distorted letters, extra text lines

params.text_accuracy: must read ONGEA PESA and by Nairobi Space of AI Tools NSAIT

brand_lock.back_text_secondary: by Nairobi Space of AI Tools · NSAIT

notes: Polo back print stays moderate in size (more corporate). The hoodie back goes large.
